name: Dorothy E. Denning
summary: Computer security pioneer known for the Lattice Model and work on database security and intrusion detection.

name: Jeffrey R. Yost
summary: Historian from the University of Minnesota who conducted this oral history interview.

name: University of Michigan
summary: Public research university in Ann Arbor, Michigan, where Denning earned her BA and MA.

name: Fred Haddock
summary: Director of Radio Astronomy at the University of Michigan who hired Denning.

name: Bernie Galler
summary: Computer science professor at the University of Michigan who taught Denning.

name: University of Rochester
summary: Private research university where Denning worked as a systems programmer for three years.

name: Peter Denning
summary: Computer scientist and Dorothy Denning's husband, collaborated on security research.

name: Purdue University
summary: Public research university where Denning earned her PhD and served as faculty.

name: Sam Conte
summary: Department chair at Purdue University who offered Denning a position.

name: Herb Schwetman
summary: Professor at Purdue who served as Denning's PhD advisor.

name: SRI International
summary: Research institute where Denning worked on intrusion detection and database security.

name: Peter Neumann
summary: Computer scientist at SRI who collaborated with Denning on security projects.

name: Karl Levitt
summary: Researcher at SRI who initiated the IDES intrusion detection project.

name: Digital Equipment Corporation
summary: Technology company where Denning worked as a principal software engineer.

name: Georgetown University
summary: University where Denning returned to academia as department chair.

name: Naval Postgraduate School
summary: Graduate school of the United States Navy where Denning was a professor in 2013.

name: Charles Babbage Institute
summary: Research center at the University of Minnesota that conducted this oral history.

name: Lattice Model for Computer Security
summary: Security model based on lattice theory developed by Denning for information flow control.

name: IDES
summary: Intrusion detection project developed at SRI with funding from the Navy.

name: Clipper Chip
summary: Encryption chip developed by NSA that Denning testified about before Congress.

name: Grand Rapids, Michigan
summary: City in Michigan where Dorothy Denning was born and grew up.

name: Monterey, California
summary: City in California where the Naval Postgraduate School is located.
